name: works-dna-extractor
title_zh: 从原文抽写作DNA，续写改编不跑调
tagline_zh: 给AI续写装上原作者的笔：先拆解叙事节奏、视角、用词习惯，再按新要求续写或改编，风格不漂移。
tagline_en: Give AI the author's pen: it first profiles narrative rhythm, POV, and diction from your source, then continues.
desc_en: extract and apply a reusable "work dna" profile from fiction source text for AI-assisted continuation, rewriting, adaptation, and style-consistent novel generation. Use when the user provides an original novel/scene/chapter and asks to analyze its writing DNA, continue it with new requirements, preserve the original narrative methods, build a style bible, evaluate continuation fidelity, or convert
why_zh: 不是靠提示词“模仿风格”碰运气，而是先把文本拆成可复用的结构化DNA档案，再让生成过程受档案约束。
why_en: Instead of hoping a prompt 'sounds like' the original, it builds a structured, reusable DNA profile first, then constrains.
limit_zh: 只处理小说/场景/章节类叙事文本，不适用诗歌、剧本或非虚构。需用户提供原文且明确要求续写/改编/分析。
limit_en: For fiction prose (novel/scene/chapter) only—not poetry, scripts, or nonfiction. Requires source text plus an explicit continuation/rewrite/analysis.
title_en: Extract writing DNA from source text for consistent.
